notes.title: Echoing Silence | Update v1.5 – What’s New
notes.content: [p]This update brings a more refined and rewarding gameplay experience, with several key improvements based on community feedback:[/p][list][*][p][b]New paths and shortcuts[/b]: Explore newly added routes and discover alternate ways to navigate the cave system.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Item name review[/b]: Several item names have been revised for clarity and consistency.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Item rebalancing[/b]: Resource values and effectiveness were fine-tuned to improve pacing and survival.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New event sequence[/b]: Changes to the progression path now create a more immersive and logical flow.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sleeping restores health[/b]: Resting in the tent now moderately restores your health — use it wisely.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved glowsticks[/b]: Extended durability makes this item much more useful in deeper areas.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks for playing and supporting the game! [/p][p]Your feedback continues to shape each update.[/p]

notes.title: Echoing Silence – Patch 1.3.8
notes.content:
[p]Echoing Silence continues to evolve thanks to the feedback and dedication of its explorers. This update focuses on refinement, clarity, and reliability, addressing minor issues while improving the overall experience.[/p][p]🔄 [b]General Fixes & Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Minor corrections to texts, paths, and certain events, improving clarity and immersion.[/p][/*][*][p]Scenario items have been repositioned for better flow and balance.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved initial guidance at the cave entrance to help orient new explorers without diminishing tension.[/p][/*][*][p]HUD fixes for some items, ensuring information is always clear and accessible.[/p][/*][*][p]Consumable items have been rebalanced for a more cohesive and challenging progression.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrections to some endgame counters (used batteries, used piles, etc.) for more accurate statistics.[/p][/*][/list][p]🏅 [b]Achievements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added 3 new Steam achievements for explorers seeking every secret.[/p][/*][/list][p]💾 [b]Critical Save System Fix[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where story items would not load correctly unless the game was restarted.
[b][u]It is highly recommended to start a new game after this update to avoid any progression issues.[/u][/b][/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you to everyone who continues to explore, test, and share feedback.
Every suggestion and report helps shape Echoing Silence into the unique journey it is becoming.[/p][p]If you enjoy the experience, consider leaving a review. Your words help Echoing Silence reach more explorers around the world.[/p]

notes.title: Echoing Silence – Patch 1.3.7
notes.content:
Echoing Silence was designed as a harsh and unforgiving experience, where every step is a decision — and every direction, a doubt.
But after carefully listening to the first explorers... it became clear that the silence can be too intense, especially at the beginning of the journey.

This update brings refinements to the feeling of exploration — without compromising immersion.

🗺️ Better guidance (v2), without losing the tension
- Objectives have been rewritten.
- Rick's thoughts have been adjusted.
- Several paths have been redesigned.

🎒 More freedom to prepare your expeditions
- You can now store additional types of items in your pockets, giving you more flexibility when preparing for each departure from base. (e.g., water bottles, juice, energy drinks, soda, etc.)

🏃 New sprint and status logic (v3)
- You can now sprint for longer — but at a higher energy cost. With low energy, the risk of falling increases. This encourages more strategic decisions and real tension.
- Slight rebalance to energy, hunger, thirst, and sanity consumption to match the new sprint logic.

🏅 New achievements to uncover
- New achievements have been added to reward true explorers — those who seek to uncover every hidden secret within the cave.

🔧 Other adjustments
- Minor path corrections.
- Small fixes to texts, translations, and directional guidance.

If you've already stepped into this cave...
Thank you — truly. Your feedback helps shape every part of this game.

If you haven’t yet, maybe this is the time to test the silence.

And if you're willing to leave a review — even a short one — it helps Echoing Silence reach more explorers like you.

Thank you for your support and trust.

notes.title: Update 1.3.0 – New mechanics and adjustments
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed text and translation issues
[*] New sprint mechanic: allows longer sprint periods but consumes more stamina. Low stamina increases the chance to stumble
[*] Reorganized and redistributed events in the early days, providing more terrain to explore in the first hour
[*] Rewrote objectives to better guide players to events
[/list]
